prompt: Composition: Aligned comparison rows, sticky labels, compact toolbar, no hero. Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Libre Baskerville; condensed display heading with reading serif. Use Apricot and Cypress: page #FFF9F3, text #293C32, accent #A84218, secondary surface #E4EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 36px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
